criteria.reason: The complete exposed first screen omits the required rejection behavior, preflight decision and consequence, and next implementation/verification outcome. The reader supplies those answers, but the visible excerpt does not support them; the full design cannot repair this omission.

evidence.quote:
# Plan
Status: proposed.
See sections 4 through 9 for behavior, rationale and stages.
Every implementation stage runs all tests, executes hooks, and follows review.
Repeat the workflow policy for every component.
Function inventory: parse_one, parse_many, validate_id, validate_item, allocate_line, write_result.

Reject the whole insufficient order without any stock debit, then continue. Preflight availability makes mutation atomic at the order level without rollback. Next implement and test rejection followed by a valid order, preserving the JSON API.
